plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 183 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.80085, -123.45995, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 360 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 7 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2009 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season: mule deer 4 point bucks Sept 10 to Sept 30 and more rows (synopsis page 44, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-deer-walk-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-13: about 8,795 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.61 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
